summary: Closing session to put numbers on the origination plan. Agreed a target cost per completed deal, a £95k proprietary programme budget and three deployment scenarios for Fund II. The abort cost cap needs IC agreement and the monitoring fee increase was rejected.

discussion.keyPoints: Including abort fees on broken deals, Mark estimated each completed deal costs around £420k to originate and close.
The founder outreach, succession report and dinners from weeks 3 and 7 come to around £95k a year. Helen wanted a clear test of whether it pays back.
Mark raised increasing the monitoring fee charged to portfolio companies. Helen felt it undermined the operator-led positioning.

recommendations.recommendation: Cut cost per completed deal, including abort costs, from around £420k to £300k.
Fund the proprietary programme at £95k a year and judge it on 2 proprietary completions by the end of 2027.
Require IC sign-off for any deal where abort costs will exceed £150k.
Plan Fund II deployment on three scenarios: low 2 deals, base 4 deals and high 5 deals a year.
Raise the annual monitoring fee charged to portfolio companies from £60k to £80k.

actions.action: Take the £150k abort cost cap to the next IC meeting
Set up quarterly tracking of cost per completed deal

nextFocus: Review progress against the 60/40 origination mix and the 2027 proprietary completions target at the quarterly check-in.
nextPreparation: Bring the Monday dashboard and the first quarter of CRM data.

tests.question: What cost per completed deal are we targeting?
How will we judge the proprietary programme?
Did we agree to raise the monitoring fee?
